IF YOU WANT TO CRACK CODING INTERVIEWS, STOP MEMORIZING SOLUTIONS.

MEMORIZE THESE 5 PATTERNS INSTEAD: 1/5

Sliding window solves most array and string problems.

If the question asks for longest, shortest, or best subarray, don't brute force. Grow the window, shrink it when invalid. 2/5

Fast and slow pointers catch what loops hide.

Cycle detection, middle of a list, happy number. Two runners at different speeds turn O(n) memory into O(1). 3/5

DP is recognition, not memorization.

Ask one question: can this be built from smaller answers? If yes, define the state, write the recurrence, fill the table. 4/5

I post daily breakdowns like this for backend, SQL, and interviews.

Follow @owlsky17 so you don't miss the next one. 5/5
